### Health Analytics with R · Module 04: Machine Learning for Clinical Prediction
***
**Learning objectives**
- Build, visualise and interpret a clinical decision tree
- Understand bias-variance tradeoff via tree depth experiments
- Fit a Random Forest and tune hyperparameters (`trees`, `tree_depth`, `min_n`)
- Extract and plot feature importances (MDI and permutation)
- Compare Decision Tree vs Random Forest on clinical holdout

**Estimated time:** 2 hours | **Level:** Intermediate | **Libraries:** `tidymodels`, `rpart`, `rpart.plot`, `ranger`, `dplyr`, `ggplot2`

## 1. Setup & Shared Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(ranger)
library(vip)
library(patchwork)
tidymodels_prefer()
set.seed(42)

mod04_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod04")
dir.create(mod04_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
col_blue <- "#2563EB"; col_red <- "#DC2626"; col_green <- "#16A34A"
col_purple <- "#7C3AED"; col_navy <- "#1E3A8A"

auc_prob   <- function(y, p) yardstick::roc_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
ap_prob    <- function(y, p) yardstick::pr_auc_vec(factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), p, event_level = "second")
brier_prob <- function(y, p) mean((p - y)^2)

# ── Dataset (same seed as NB-01) ──────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42); N <- 3000
sig <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))
clip <- function(x, lo, hi) pmin(pmax(x, lo), hi)
b <- matrix(rnorm(N * 4), ncol = 4); set.seed(99)
age <- as.integer(clip(rnorm(N, 62, 15), 18, 92))
sex <- sample(c("M", "F"), N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.48, 0.52))
payer <- sample(c("Medicare", "Medicaid", "Private", "Self-pay", "Other"),
                N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.40, 0.22, 0.28, 0.07, 0.03))
admit_type <- sample(c("Emergency", "Elective", "Urgent"),
                     N, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.52, 0.30, 0.18))
los_days <- as.integer(clip(round(rgamma(N, shape = 2.5, scale = 1.8)), 1, 30))
diabetes <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.6 * b[, 1] - 0.5 + 0.02 * (age - 62) / 15))
hypertension <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.7 * b[, 1] - 0.2))
hf <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.4 * b[, 2] + 0.5 * hypertension - 1.5))
copd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 3] - 1.0))
ckd <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] + 0.6 * diabetes - 1.2))
obesity <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.5 * b[, 1] - 0.8))
depression <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(0.3 * b[, 4] - 1.4))
n_comorb <- diabetes + hypertension + hf + copd + ckd
set.seed(21)
glucose <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 105 + 15 * diabetes, 28), 50, 400), 1)
creatinine <- round(clip(rgamma(N, shape = 1.6 + 0.8 * hf, scale = 0.6), 0.4, 10), 2)
hba1c <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 6.5 + 0.8 * diabetes, 1.4), 4, 14), 1)
sbp <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 128 + 12 * hypertension, 18), 80, 200), 0)
bmi <- round(clip(rnorm(N, 28 + 4 * obesity, 6), 15, 55), 1)
logit <- (-3.2 + 0.6 * hf + 0.5 * diabetes + 0.5 * ckd + 0.3 * copd +
            0.02 * (age - 62) / 15 +
            0.3 * as.integer(admit_type == "Emergency") +
            0.25 * as.integer(payer == "Medicaid") +
            0.2 * as.integer(los_days > 7) +
            0.5 * hf * diabetes + rnorm(N, 0, 0.25))
readmitted <- rbinom(N, 1, sig(logit))
df <- tibble(
  age, sex, payer, admit_type, los_days,
  diabetes, hypertension, hf, copd, ckd, obesity, depression, n_comorb,
  glucose, creatinine, hba1c, sbp, bmi, readmitted
)
df$los_gt7 <- as.integer(df$los_days > 7)
NUMERIC <- c("age", "los_days", "n_comorb", "glucose", "creatinine", "hba1c", "sbp", "bmi")
BINARY <- c("diabetes", "hypertension", "hf", "copd", "ckd", "obesity", "depression", "los_gt7")
CATEGORIC <- c("sex", "payer", "admit_type")
FEATURES <- c(NUMERIC, BINARY, CATEGORIC); TARGET <- "readmitted"

# ── Preprocessing + split ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(42)
df_ml <- df %>%
  select(all_of(c(FEATURES, TARGET))) %>%
  mutate(readmitted = factor(readmitted, levels = c(0, 1)))
split <- initial_split(df_ml, prop = 0.80, strata = readmitted)
df_tr <- training(split); df_te <- testing(split)
y_tr <- as.integer(as.character(df_tr$readmitted))
y_te <- as.integer(as.character(df_te$readmitted))

rec <- recipe(readmitted ~ ., data = df_tr) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_normalize(all_of(NUMERIC)) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_of(BINARY)) %>%
  step_impute_mode(all_of(CATEGORIC)) %>%
  step_dummy(all_of(CATEGORIC), one_hot = TRUE)
rec_prep <- prep(rec, training = df_tr)
Xtr_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_tr) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xte_tbl <- bake(rec_prep, new_data = df_te) %>% select(-readmitted)
Xtr <- as.matrix(Xtr_tbl); Xte <- as.matrix(Xte_tbl)
feat_names <- colnames(Xtr)
cat(sprintf("Train: %d x %d | Test: %d x %d | Positive rate: %.1f%%\n",
            nrow(Xtr), ncol(Xtr), nrow(Xte), ncol(Xte), mean(y_tr) * 100))
```

## 2. Decision Tree — Building Intuition

```{r}
# Shallow tree (depth=4) for interpretability
set.seed(42)
w_bal <- ifelse(y_tr == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 0))
dt_data <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr, levels = c(0, 1)))
dt_shallow <- rpart(
  readmitted ~ ., data = dt_data, method = "class", weights = w_bal,
  control = rpart.control(maxdepth = 4, minsplit = 20, cp = 0, xval = 0)
)
prob_dt <- predict(dt_shallow, newdata = Xte_tbl, type = "prob")[, "1"]
auc_dt <- auc_prob(y_te, prob_dt)
cat(sprintf("Decision Tree (depth=4): AUC = %.4f\n", auc_dt))

# Visualise the tree
png(file.path(mod04_dir, "decision_tree.png"), width = 14, height = 8, units = "in", res = 150)
rpart.plot(
  dt_shallow, extra = 104, under = TRUE, fallen.leaves = TRUE,
  box.palette = "RdBu", roundint = FALSE, cex = 0.7,
  main = "Decision Tree (max_depth=4) — 30-day readmission prediction"
)
dev.off()
rpart.plot(
  dt_shallow, extra = 104, under = TRUE, fallen.leaves = TRUE,
  box.palette = "RdBu", roundint = FALSE, cex = 0.7,
  main = "Decision Tree (max_depth=4) — 30-day readmission prediction"
)
```

```{r}
# Text representation — easier for clinical reporting
cat("Decision tree rules (first 60 lines):\n")
rules <- capture.output(print(dt_shallow))
cat(paste(head(rules, 60), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

## 3. Bias-Variance Tradeoff — Tree Depth Experiment

```{r}
set.seed(42)
depths <- 1:20
skf <- vfold_cv(dt_data, v = 5, strata = readmitted)

cv_at_depth <- function(d) {
  map_dbl(skf$splits, function(sp) {
    tr <- analysis(sp); te <- assessment(sp)
    w  <- ifelse(tr$readmitted == "1", 0.5 / mean(tr$readmitted == "1"),
                 0.5 / mean(tr$readmitted == "0"))
    fit <- rpart(readmitted ~ ., data = tr, method = "class", weights = w,
                 control = rpart.control(maxdepth = d, minsplit = 20, cp = 0, xval = 0))
    p <- predict(fit, newdata = te, type = "prob")[, "1"]
    auc_prob(as.integer(as.character(te$readmitted)), p)
  }) %>% mean()
}

test_aucs <- map_dbl(depths, cv_at_depth)
best_depth <- depths[which.max(test_aucs)]

depth_df <- tibble(depth = depths, cv_auc = test_aucs)
ggplot(depth_df, aes(depth, cv_auc)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = cv_auc - 0.01, ymax = cv_auc + 0.01), fill = col_navy, alpha = 0.10) +
  geom_line(colour = col_navy, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(colour = col_navy, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = best_depth, colour = col_red, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 4, colour = "#D97706", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = best_depth + 0.4, y = 0.52,
           label = sprintf("Optimal depth=%d", best_depth), colour = col_red, hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.3, y = 0.55, label = "Depth=4 (interpretable)",
           colour = "#D97706", hjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 0.85)) +
  labs(x = "Tree depth", y = "CV AUC-ROC",
       title = "Bias-variance tradeoff — tree depth vs CV AUC")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "tree_depth.png"), width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 120)
cat(sprintf("Best CV depth: %d (AUC=%.4f)\n", best_depth, max(test_aucs)))
cat("Deep trees overfit: train accuracy keeps rising while CV AUC plateaus/drops\n")
```

## 4. Random Forest

```{r}
set.seed(42)
rf_df <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(readmitted = factor(y_tr, levels = c(0, 1)))
# class.weights balanced analogue
cw <- c("0" = 1 / mean(y_tr == 0), "1" = 1 / mean(y_tr == 1))
rf <- ranger(
  readmitted ~ ., data = rf_df, probability = TRUE,
  num.trees = 300, max.depth = 10, min.node.size = 10,
  mtry = floor(sqrt(ncol(Xtr))), class.weights = cw,
  importance = "impurity", seed = 42
)
prob_rf  <- predict(rf, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"]
auc_rf   <- auc_prob(y_te, prob_rf)
ap_rf    <- ap_prob(y_te, prob_rf)
brier_rf <- brier_prob(y_te, prob_rf)
cat(sprintf("Random Forest: AUC=%.4f | Avg Precision=%.4f | Brier=%.4f\n", auc_rf, ap_rf, brier_rf))
cat(sprintf("Decision Tree (depth=4): AUC=%.4f\n", auc_dt))
cat(sprintf("AUC improvement: %+.4f\n", auc_rf - auc_dt))
```

## 5. Feature Importance — MDI vs Permutation

```{r}
# MDI (Mean Decrease Impurity) — built-in, fast but biased toward high-cardinality features
mdi_vi <- vip::vi(rf) %>% slice_max(Importance, n = 15)
mdi_imp <- tibble(feature = mdi_vi$Variable, importance = mdi_vi$Importance)

# Permutation importance — model-agnostic, unbiased (evaluated on the test set)
set.seed(42)
base_auc <- auc_prob(y_te, predict(rf, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"])
perm_imp <- map_dfr(feat_names, function(col) {
  drops <- replicate(10, {
    Xp <- Xte_tbl
    Xp[[col]] <- sample(Xp[[col]])
    base_auc - auc_prob(y_te, predict(rf, data = Xp)$predictions[, "1"])
  })
  tibble(feature = col, importance = mean(drops))
}) %>% arrange(desc(importance)) %>% slice_head(n = 15)

p_mdi <- ggplot(mdi_imp, aes(x = importance, y = reorder(feature, importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = col_blue, alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", importance)), hjust = -0.05, size = 2.8) +
  labs(x = "Importance score", y = NULL,
       title = "MDI Feature Importance (built-in, biased toward high-cardinality)")

p_perm <- ggplot(perm_imp, aes(x = importance, y = reorder(feature, importance))) +
  geom_col(fill = col_red, alpha = 0.85, colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.4f", importance)), hjust = -0.05, size = 2.8) +
  labs(x = "Importance score", y = NULL,
       title = "Permutation Importance (model-agnostic, evaluated on test set)")

p_mdi + p_perm
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "feature_importance.png"), width = 14, height = 6, dpi = 120)
cat("Top 5 features (permutation importance):\n")
walk2(head(perm_imp$feature, 5), head(perm_imp$importance, 5),
      ~ cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %.4f\n", .x, .y)))
```

## 6. Hyperparameter Tuning with `tune::tune_grid`

```{r}
set.seed(42)
rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  trees = tune(), min_n = tune(), mtry = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, seed = 42,
             class.weights = cw) %>%
  set_mode("classification")

rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(rf_spec) %>%
  add_formula(readmitted ~ .)

folds <- vfold_cv(rf_df, v = 3, strata = readmitted)
# n_estimators 100/200; min_samples_leaf 5/15; max_features sqrt/log2
p_feat <- ncol(Xtr)
grid_rf <- expand_grid(
  trees = c(100, 200),
  min_n = c(5, 15),
  mtry  = c(max(1, floor(log2(p_feat))), max(1, floor(sqrt(p_feat))))
)

gs <- tune_grid(
  rf_wf, resamples = folds, grid = grid_rf,
  metrics = metric_set(roc_auc),
  control = control_grid(save_pred = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
)

best_params <- select_best(gs, metric = "roc_auc")
final_rf <- finalize_workflow(rf_wf, best_params) %>% fit(rf_df)
prob_best <- predict(final_rf, new_data = Xte_tbl, type = "prob")$.pred_1
auc_best  <- auc_prob(y_te, prob_best)
best_cv   <- collect_metrics(gs) %>% filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
  arrange(desc(mean)) %>% slice(1)

cat("Best parameters:\n")
print(best_params)
cat(sprintf("CV AUC (best): %.4f\n", best_cv$mean))
cat(sprintf("Test AUC (best RF): %.4f\n", auc_best))
cat(sprintf("Test AUC (default RF): %.4f\n", auc_rf))
```

## 7. ROC Comparison

```{r}
set.seed(42)
lr_df <- Xtr_tbl %>% mutate(y = y_tr)
w_lr <- ifelse(y_tr == 1, 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 1), 0.5 / mean(y_tr == 0))
lr <- glm(y ~ ., data = lr_df, family = binomial, weights = w_lr)
prob_lr <- predict(lr, newdata = Xte_tbl, type = "response")

roc_one <- function(y, p, label) {
  yardstick::roc_curve(
    tibble(truth = factor(y, levels = c(0, 1)), .pred = p),
    truth, .pred, event_level = "second"
  ) %>% mutate(model = label)
}
roc_df <- bind_rows(
  roc_one(y_te, prob_lr,   sprintf("Logistic Regression (AUC=%.3f)", auc_prob(y_te, prob_lr))),
  roc_one(y_te, prob_dt,   sprintf("Decision Tree d=4 (AUC=%.3f)", auc_dt)),
  roc_one(y_te, prob_rf,   sprintf("Random Forest def (AUC=%.3f)", auc_rf)),
  roc_one(y_te, prob_best, sprintf("RF tuned (AUC=%.3f)", auc_best))
)
pal <- c(col_green, col_purple, col_blue, col_red)
names(pal) <- unique(roc_df$model)

ggplot(roc_df, aes(1 - specificity, sensitivity, colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(x = "1-Specificity", y = "Sensitivity", colour = NULL,
       title = "ROC curves — Decision Tree vs Random Forest variants") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(file.path(mod04_dir, "roc_comparison.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 120)
```

## 8. Knowledge Check
1. Why does a single deep decision tree overfit while a random forest with deep trees does not?
2. Permutation importance for `hf` is much lower than MDI importance. What might explain this discrepancy?
3. Your RF has 300 trees. A colleague says 1000 trees would always be better. Is this true?
4. The tree split on `creatinine > 1.45` at the root. Is this clinically plausible?
5. Re-train the RF with balanced bootstrap sampling (`sample.fraction` stratified). How does AUC change on the test set?

```{r}
# Exercise 5
set.seed(42)
rf_bs <- ranger(
  readmitted ~ ., data = rf_df, probability = TRUE,
  num.trees = 200, max.depth = 10,
  sample.fraction = c(0.5, 0.5), seed = 42
)
auc_bs <- auc_prob(y_te, predict(rf_bs, data = Xte_tbl)$predictions[, "1"])
cat(sprintf("RF balanced            AUC=%.4f\n", auc_rf))
cat(sprintf("RF balanced_subsample  AUC=%.4f\n", auc_bs))
cat(sprintf("Difference: %+.4f\n", auc_bs - auc_rf))
```
